title: GRAIN — Geodynamics Research Analogue Information Network
description:
GRAIN is a MATLAB toolset that turns analogue (sandbox) tectonic experiments into quantitative, reproducible kinematic data. It wraps PIVlab in a batch pipeline running from time-lapse photographs to fault-by-fault measurements: velocity magnitude and shear-strain fields, plot-over-time (POT) curves, hanging-wall/footwall velocities, net slip, fault geometry, and a frame-by-frame description table.

Design principles: one experiment = one self-contained file; all corrections (frame exclusion, jitter stabilisation, masking) stored as non-destructive recipes; every measurement replayable from JSON sidecars.

This deposit contains source code and documentation only. Photographic data, PIV result files and exported figures are archived separately. Requires MATLAB R2025b and PIVlab (not bundled).
